summary: Post-payment experience and Stripe payout reconciliation. payments gains the Bedrock confirmation number (BP-XXXX-XXXX, unique on the assessment row, format CHECK) and the once-only notice record for the receipt and the ACH 'submitted' email (claimed/sent/message id, recipient, last error), plus payment_new_confirmation_number(). Existing assessment payment groups are backfilled with a confirmation number (updates only). bank_rec_payouts (migration 240) gains the Stripe payout columns (payout id, balance transaction id UNIQUE, charge, PaymentIntent, payment FK, status, arrival date, payout amount, resolution and note, updated_at with its trigger). No rows are added or removed; existing Vantaca payout rows keep NULL in every new column.

preflight.name: payments.confirmation_number does not exist yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'payments' AND column_name = 'confirmation_number'

preflight.name: bank_rec_payouts.balance_txn_id does not exist yet
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'bank_rec_payouts' AND column_name = 'balance_txn_id'

expected_changes: payments: adds nullable confirmation_number (CHECK format), receipt_email, receipt_claimed_at, receipt_sent_at, receipt_message_id, submitted_notice_claimed_at, submitted_notice_sent_at, submitted_notice_message_id, notice_error.
payments: unique index on confirmation_number for the assessment row; partial index on notice_error.
payments: every existing assessment payment group gets one confirmation number on all its rows (UPDATE only; net row count unchanged).

bank_rec_payouts: adds nullable processor_payout_id, balance_txn_id (UNIQUE), charge_id, payment_intent_id, payment_id (FK payments, RESTRICT), payout_status (CHECK paid/failed), arrival_date, payout_amount_cents, resolution (CHECK tied/unresolved), resolution_note, updated_at; two indexes; the updated_at trigger. No rows change.
Grants on bank_rec_payouts restated (already present from migration 240).

verify.name: every assessment payment group has a confirmation number
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM payments WHERE product_type = 'assessment_payment' AND payment_group_id IS NOT NULL AND confirmation_number IS NULL

verify.name: each confirmation number belongs to one payment group
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM (SELECT confirmation_number FROM payments WHERE confirmation_number IS NOT NULL GROUP BY confirmation_number HAVING count(DISTINCT payment_group_id) > 1) x

verify.name: no existing payout row was given Stripe data
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM bank_rec_payouts WHERE balance_txn_id IS NOT NULL OR processor_payout_id IS NOT NULL OR payout_status IS NOT NULL
